messages:
maya: Quick sync request — we need bench assets for next week's webinar and a short launch post. Can eng dump final numbers by EOD tomorrow? cc @kevin @sam

sam: On it. High-level ask: two hero visuals (slide + social card), a small explainer graphic for cache impact, and three headline variants for A/B testing.

kevin: I'll run a mixed workload profile tonight. Latest numbers (rough): p50=22ms, p95=90ms, p99=210ms on hosted. With Dedicated reserved pool it's roughly 20% lower p95. I'll include cache-on vs cache-off traces.

zoe: Design note: keep colors consistent across assets — latency=navy, cost=coral. Social card needs legible text at 1200x628 and square variant at 1080x1080. Also export with transparent bg for partner promos.

arjun: Messaging POV: emphasize "predictable unit economics" rather than raw speed. Proposed hero lines:
- "Predictable latency, predictable cost — ship with confidence."
- "Cut your inference spend without sacrificing responsiveness."

sam: I like the first for developer audiences. Second for case studies/ads. We'll A/B test. Add micro-CTAs: "Try bench playground" vs "See our method".

kevin: Running: `./bench/run --preset webinar_v3 --cache prefix --out csv`. Job id 8812. Expect outputs in ~90m. Will attach CSV and PNGs here.

benchbot: job 8812 started by kevin. logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/8812 ETA 1h30m

leo: Inbound plan: landing form will capture interest (Generation / Chat / Embeddings), company size, and infra preference (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Route Dedicated-interest leads to enterprise SDRs, everything else to PLG queue. Add utm params: utm_campaign=bench_webinar_v3

zoe: For charts I'm planning:
1) latency vs cost scatter (log-cost axis)
2) tail violin by model family (chat/generation/embedding)
3) cache-delta ribbon overlay (cache_on vs cache_off)
Please confirm exact pixel sizes: slide 1280x720, social 1200x628, hero banner 1600x400.

maya: Confirmed. Also include a tiny legend converting tokens->$ (example: 1k tokens ≈ $0.10 baseline, $0.05 with batching). That cut-through helps non-technical reviewers.

arjun: Subject line candidates for email blast:
- "How we cut inference spend while keeping latency predictable"
- "Benchmarks: predictable latency, better unit economics"
- "See the numbers: latency vs cost for real LLM workloads"

sam: Nice. Also advise we add a one-line enterprise blurb: "Dedicated pools with SLA and automatic fallback keep critical paths online."

kevin: Added a small table of assumptions to the CSV (seq_len, batch_size, quantization). Will paste when job finishes. Note: cache-on p95 in some flows <40ms.

zoe: Draft visuals on Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/bench_launch_v3 — commented on accessible contrast and will push alt text for images.

maya: Scheduling final creative review tomorrow 11:00. Invite to marketing/eng/design. If eng finishes runs earlier, we'll push the landing live same day.

sam: Thanks everyone. Small PR reminder: include model-variant routing note in the blog (we fallback to cheaper variants when load is high). Makes the "no surprise bill" claim clearer.

benchbot: job 8812 completed. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/8812.zip

kevin: Uploading CSV + PNG exports now. I'll flag the three hero PNGs in the artifact root.

maya: Great—I'll prep the landing draft and email copy after the review.

sam: :thumbsup: Let's prioritize launch post + webinar CTA. If we have time, spin a short case-study vignette for the enterprise page.
